board_size_policy.order: min(market_cap_percentile, turnover_percentile) desc; then mean percentile, projected_yest, industry-relative return, ticker
board_size_policy.seat_priority: current members first in rank order, then new entrants in rank order
board_size_policy.rule: every name passing every fixed requirement (market cap >= US$5bn, projected turnover >= US$100m) and not banned is eligible; at most 50 are listed

criteria.normalization_basis: within-market empirical percentiles of market cap and projected full-day USD turnover

new_entry_cutoff_policy.rule: admissions at any time while the session is open, from 09:30 to 15:30 ET (exchange-local); no new US entries after 15:30 ET; after 15:30 current members may exit but no entrant is admitted; at most 50 names passing the fixed gates are listed, current members first, then new entrants in rank order

no_reentry_policy.rule: a name removed at or after 10:00 ET cannot re-enter for the remainder of that trading session; removals before 10:00 ET do not ban

selection_window.admissions: at any time while the session is open (09:30-15:30); no new US entries after 15:30 ET
selection_window.rank_exits: members ranked beyond 50 leave on rank (policy change only)
selection_window.after_close: no new entries; exits only (fixed gates, missing data, ban)
selection_window.old_timer_rule: present at this session's and the previous session's 15:30 close (consecutive closes, >= 2)

criteria.entry_rank: display order only: highest min(market_cap_percentile, turnover_percentile); then mean percentile, projected_yest, industry-relative return
criteria.entry_requirement_text: Names qualify at any time while the session is open (09:30-15:30 ET, exchange-local); no new US entries after 15:30 ET, and the board at 15:30 is the session's selection. After 15:30 there are no new entries, only exits. At most 50 names are listed: current members keep their place while they pass, and free places go to new entrants in rank order. Every name needs a market cap of at least US$5bn and projected turnover of at least US$100m, and must beat its industry by more than 0.01 percentage points. Every displayed name must remain above +0.5% from this session's open, beat its industry on the same open-to-current basis, stay above 1.5× projected yesterday's turnover and hold the Drop Out Zone. Any failed requirement or missing current data removes the name on that refresh, and a name removed at or after 10:00 ET cannot re-enter for the rest of the session. Removals before 10:00 ET do not ban. After the 15:30 ET close exits are not backfilled; names can only leave the list. A name present at this session's and the previous session's 15:30 close is an old timer.

exit_rule.name: continuous membership requalification
exit_rule.condition: any fixed gate failure, missing current data or the same-session ban
exit_rule.missing_data_policy: withhold from the current list and report missing evidence

criteria.exit_condition_text: A member is removed when it fails a current requirement or its current data is missing. Requirements include vs Industry, intraday return, ×Yest > 1.5 and the Drop Out Zone. After 15:30 exits are the fixed requirements only and the board is not refilled. From 10:00 ET, removal bans re-entry for the rest of the session. Removal before 10:00 ET does not ban re-entry.

tenure_policy.basis: consecutive session selection closes (current epoch; v10 keeps v9's session-close rule: each market's own session close)

previous_turnover_policy.basis: immediately preceding session, one date for every ticker
